when / while and the past continuous · 阶: was/were doing + when + past simple: the continuous is the background, the past simple is the interrupting event.本课为阶段复盘练习,核心:The longer action in the past continuous is the background; the shorter action in the past simple interrupts it。

when + past simple: sudden short action|while + past continuous: ongoing background|was doing when did = was in the middle of doing something when something happened|while can join two parallel continuous actions|when can replace while + state, but not vice versa
I was doing my homework when the phone rang.
column3: 我正在做作业,这时电话响了。

# title: I _____ my homework when the phone rang.
column4: 考查The longer action in the past continuous is the background; the shorter action in the past simple interrupts it。此处应为 was doing。句意:我正在做作业,这时电话响了。
